Breakfast corresponds to dinner: Breakfast and dinner are the main meals of a day, taken in the morning and evening respectively.
Start corresponds to end: Start and end are the two endpoints of a process, representing the beginning and end of a process, respectively.
Coffee corresponds to wine: Coffee and wine are common drinks in their respective meals of breakfast and dinner, representing the characteristics of each meal.

background.source: Eating breakfast is the perfect way to start your morning right by breaking the overnight fasting period and fueling your body with the energy it needs to carry out daily activities with ease. Breakfast is considered as the most important meal of the day as it plays a crucial role in providing essential nutrients and minerals that keep the body healthy and active. The breakfast menus can be customized according to regional and traditional preferences to suit one’s taste buds. While some prefer a classic American breakfast with eggs, bacon, and pancakes, others opt for a healthy continental breakfast with fruits, cereals, and yogurt. Accompanied by a hot cup of coffee, breakfast not only stimulates cognitive function but also aids in digestion and supports a healthy metabolism. Hence, it is always advisable to make breakfast an integral part of your daily routine for a healthy and fulfilling life.
background.target: Eating dinner is a crucial part of the daily routine in many cultures around the world. In Western cultures, it is usually the largest and most formal meal, often consumed in the evening towards the end of the day. The concept of dinner has evolved over time and now holds different meanings based on cultural and geographical factors. Some regions still associate it with midday meals, while others may have it at any time of the day. Regardless of when it is eaten, dinner often involves a variety of delicious and nutritious food items accompanied by a glass of wine for some.
